title: Thy Presence, Gracious God, Afford
description: Thy Presence, Gracious God, Afford in Tonic Solfa to OLD HUNDREDTH, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 23 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “For Opening or Close of Service”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Long Metre (8.8.8.8), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to OLD HUNDREDTH; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Thy pre-sence, gra-cious God, af-ford; Pre-pare us to re-ceive thy word; Now let thy voice en-gage our ear, And faith be mixed with what we hear.

lines: Prepare us to receive thy word;
Now let thy voice engage our ear,
And faith be mixed with what we hear.
And fix our hearts and hopes above;
With food divine may we be fed,
To us the sacred word apply
And may we, in thy faith and fear,
Reduce to practice what we hear.
Father, in us thy Son reveal;
Teach us to know and do thy will;
Thy saving power and love display,
And guide us to the realms of day.

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to OLD HUNDREDTH by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
